title: Engineer / Technical Officer - Road Design (East)
screening_questions: Works collaboratively, sharing information, supporting colleagues and contributing positively to team goals.
Delivers work effectively, prioritising tasks by urgency and impact, working to agreed plans and maintaining accurate project records.
Applies sound judgement and problem-solving skills, using established policies and processes and seeking guidance when needed.
Applies foundational engineering knowledge professionally, using relevant standards, guidelines, codes and risk controls to develop and document practical engineering solutions.
Adaptable and technically capable, open to new approaches and developing skills in road and traffic engineering, roadside safety, and CAD tools including MicroStation and OpenRoads.
Ability to travel within the state for site inspections (required).
